title: 3D spatial chart (strata, footprint stacks)
question: Can an AI agent separate overlapping events by year in 3D?
answer: On the MapLibre engine, yes: a spatialChart lifts each group (such as a year) into its own virtual-Z slot, or extrudes by a measure, without changing the source polygons. It is a display technique, not overlay analysis.
triggers: Separate overlapping fire perimeters by year
Stack these events in 3D by year
Make a five-part 3D brief of fire history
inputTypes: Polygon layer with a group (year) field

required.name: groupBy
required.description: Field with at most 40 distinct values.

steps.action: Read llms.txt, this recipe and api/capabilities.json; note the engine and execution environment you actually have.
Read the source metadata: geometry type, field names and types, spatial reference, extent, sentinels and query support. Query real values before filtering; never invent fields.
Add spatialChart to the map-v1 layer, or call briefing.generateTemplate({ template: "spatial-3d-chart" }) in the page.
Check the Z legend, the strata order and source-event identify.

artifact.structure: map-v1 layer.spatialChart, or briefing slides with spatialChart.

limitations: Fast display: no exact overlap partition or unique-area totals.
recovery: Filter the layer or use a coarser group field when there are more than 40 values.
